title: Southline Capacity Contract Current Program Record
summary: DOE continues to list $477 million awarded to the proposed 175-mile, 748 MW Southline project while the same program page distinguishes active projects from withdrawals and terminations.
key_findings: Southline remains listed as a $477 million awarded capacity-contract action.
The proposed first phase connects Hidalgo County, New Mexico and Pima County, Arizona.
The page's expected construction timing is not a verified construction-progress record.
why_it_matters: The program page preserves Southline as an active financial trail while demonstrating why a selection or award must remain separate from construction and energized capacity.
ftfn_relevance: Maintains a project-level transmission finance anchor for the Southwest.
Sets a stop rule against treating an expected construction date as observed progress.
evidence_limits: The page does not prove notice to proceed, physical construction, interconnection, energization, or delivery of 748 MW.
Current project-level permit and construction records are still required.
